items.title: 18.4 Predicting Formula and Charge of a Complex Ion (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of predicting the formula and charge of a complex ion (PDF 24).

blocks.text: Complex ion ka formula aur charge markazi dhaat ke ion, us ke oxidation state, aur ligands aur un ke charges se nikalte hain. Aam shakal [M(L)x]y hai, jahan M markazi dhaat ka ion, L ligand, x ligands ki tadaad (coordination number se tay) aur y kul charge hai, musbat, manfi ya sifar.

blocks.caption: Complex ion ka formula aur charge maloom karna (kitab ka Table 18.3)
rows: Dhaat ka ion aur oxidation state
Charge = dhaat ka charge + (ligands ki tadaad x ligand ka charge)

blocks.title: Formula likhna
blocks.text: Pehle dhaat, phir ligand aur us ki tadaad subscript ke taur par, sab square brackets ke andar likhein, aur kul charge brackets ke bahar superscript ke taur par lagayein.

blocks.prompt: Cu2+ aur chaar Cl- ligands se banne wale complex ka formula aur charge batayein.

items: [M(L)x]y: charge y = dhaat ka charge + x guna ligand ka charge.
